## What to do

1. Read each thread (open its link, or the code at the path and line).
2. If you agree with a finding, fix it.
3. If you reject a finding, reply on its thread with your reason:
   `gh api repos/eltmon/overdeck/pulls/5085/comments/<thread id>/replies -f body="<reason>"`
4. If you changed code: run the quality gates on what you touched, commit, push, then run `pan review request PAN-5083`.
   If you only replied, you are done.
5. If PR #5085 has already merged when you read this, nothing more lands on it: open a follow-up issue
   for the findings you agree with instead of pushing.
